# Testsigma

> > Testsigma is a cloud-based test automation platform offering no-code automation for web, mobile, and API testing with AI-powered capabilities.

Testsigma provides comprehensive test automation solutions with natural language processing (NLP) for creating tests, cross-browser testing, CI/CD integrations with Jenkins and Azure DevOps, and alternatives to tools like Selenium, Cypress, and ACCELQ. The platform supports continuous testing across multiple environments and frameworks.

## Key Topics

- Test Automation
- No-Code Automation
- API Testing
- Cross-Browser Testing
- Mobile Testing (Appium, Espresso)
- CI/CD Integration (Jenkins, GitLab)
- Selenium & Cypress Alternatives
- BDD Frameworks (Cucumber, JBehave)
- Quality Assurance Process
- Automated GUI Testing
- Tool Comparisons (ACCELQ, Tosca, Postman)
- Software Testing Methodologies
- Continuous Integration
- Desktop Test Recorder
- Azure DevOps Integration
